title: Joel's Quiet (Chas McIvor)
style: country blues acoustic guitar warm baritone male vocal storytelling 98bpm walking bass brushed drums honest character portrait unhurried family Perth youngest son
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Joel was the quietest of the three from the start
He listened before he talked and he watched before his art
Came out of him at the angle nobody predicted
He chose his own direction and by that direction, lived it

[Pre-Chorus]
There's a kind of strength that doesn't need to prove the strength
Joel's had it since he was ten — and for the longest length

[Chorus]
Joel's quiet, Joel's quiet
Not the silence of having nothing — the silence of the complete
Joel's quiet, Joel's quiet
He doesn't need the room to validate the seat
Joel's quiet is the kind of quiet that a room adjusts to
Not the absence of a voice — the presence of someone who's true
That's my boy

[Verse 2]
He went from Zimbabwe to Australia as a young man finding his feet
And put them down in Perth and found the whole thing bittersweet
But sweet enough to build on and build on is what he did
The youngest son of Chas and Wilma — Joel — my kid

[Bridge]
Some people fill the silence with anything that fits
Joel fills the silence by being present every bit
He has his father's dry precision and his mother's steady warmth
And something that is purely Joel that came with the reform
Of his own character — patient and assured

[Outro]
Joel knows who he is… always has…
That's my boy
